title: Bozhou rebellion
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Bozhou rebellion", at revision 1370606170, opens: "The Bozhou rebellion, or the Yang Yinglong rebellion, was an uprising led by Yang Yinglong, a chieftain of the Miao tribes located on the border of the Ming provinces of Huguang, Guizhou, and Sichuan in southwestern China. This rebellion took place in the 1590s and was aimed at challenging the rule of the Wanli Emperor." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11078577, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1590–1600 rebellion in Ming China". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
